What I’m learning

I wanted to do something seriously, so I started doing research with a professor and trying my own projects.

Research project · Data preprocessing complete · Python / NumPy / pandas / SciPy

Pre-FoG

Working with a professor, I’m studying whether gait data recorded by ankle sensors can give a warning 1–3 seconds before freezing of gait occurs. The research targets Parkinson’s patients who suffer from freezing of gait. Training data preparation is done; model training is still to come.

Source code not yet public

Lecture PPT Outline Generator Mini Program

Built for classmates who need to organize lecture notes: it turns photos of PPT slides into an editable outline. You can proofread against the original photos, then export to Word for review after class.

Source code not yet public

Evidence-Map

A code map for beginners who write code with AI, helping them understand their own projects and know where to start changing things next. It is currently a local prototype that shows the file structure, reading routes through parts of the code, and explanations with source line numbers.

Source code not yet public
